notes.subject: skelim bilong tempel
notes.rationale: Continuation of the architectural survey: windows, shoulders, side rooms, beams.

notes.subject: אטמות
notes.rationale: Closed/beveled windows — 'narrow windows' (KJV) vs 'closed windows' (ASV) vs 'beveled' (BSB); Hebrew root means 'close up'.

notes.subject: ol sol
notes.rationale: כתפות is literally 'shoulders', kept as body picture applied to architecture.

notes.subject: ol smel rum
notes.rationale: צלעות literally 'ribs', i.e. side chambers of the temple structure.

translation: Na ol windo ol i tapim stret, na ol pos bilong palm long hia na long hia, long ol sol bilong ⟨׃⟩ veranda, na ol smel rum bilong haus, na ol traipela diwai bilong antap.

tokens.gloss: na ol traipela diwai bilong antap
